title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: When you remove a feature from a model, think about how it might affect the model's ability to fit the training data. Consider what happens to the complexity of the model and how that might influence the Mean Squared Error (MSE) on the training data.

title: Effect of Feature Removal on Model Complexity
text: What happens to the complexity of a model when you remove a feature?

title: Linking Complexity to MSE
text: With a decrease in model complexity, consider how the model's ability to fit the training data might change. Does a simpler model fit the training data better or worse?

title: Impact on MSE with Reduced Complexity
text: How might a decrease in model complexity affect the MSE on the training data?
choices: The MSE will stay the same.
